japan38_trait_coverage.important_boundary: Cirsium japonicum var. horridum has only broad Cirsium japonicum image-trait coverage, so it is retained as binomial-level sensitivity and not an exact infraspecific trait assignment.

new_bottleneck.finding: The global Azami trait atlas can be linked directly to more than half of its taxa in current nuclear resources, but the Japanese 38-concept radiation is much more sparsely covered by image traits.
new_bottleneck.consequence: A radiation-wide Japanese trait-rate analysis cannot rely on the current Azami Chapter 1 trait atlas alone. Missing Japanese trait data are a trait-coverage gap, not a reason to resequence already represented species for phylogenetic placement.
new_bottleneck.next_public_data_action: Before new field sampling, search public images/herbarium/flora evidence specifically for the 27 Japan-38 concepts lacking Azami binomial coverage and assess whether orientation/colour/outline/involucre proxies can be recovered under the existing measurement ontology.
new_bottleneck.tree_dependency: Formal trait-rate and ancestral-state tests still wait for the accepted EAzami nuclear topology ensemble and branch lengths.

claim_boundary: Exact normalized taxon-name overlap is a coverage audit only. It does not establish voucher equivalence, population phenotype identity, direct ancestry, evolutionary rate, adaptation or an ancestral state.
